history.summary: Large (1,206-unit) 2023 leasehold next to Marymount MRT with a credible 5.0% resale CAGR over 347 transactions and an asking PSF ($2,068) a solid ~13% below the project median ($2,371) — a genuinely cheap entry into a deep, liquid, MRT-adjacent development. The recurring knock on Qingjian is finishing/defect quality, but at this price the unit is well-positioned for a 5-7yr investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: 527sqft 2BR at $1.09M / $2,068 psf sits ~13% under the URA median PSF of $2,371 with 347 transactions and 5.0% resale-only CAGR (reliable, high-confidence data). 450m to Marymount CC16 plus Bishan-Ang Mo Kio mature-estate demand gives deep buyer pool and a wide tenant base for a compact 2BR. MMR 1548 / score 791, on frontier. Entry below median PSF is the core of the thesis.

history.summary: Genuinely the cheapest 1BR in a strong, recently-completed Marymount-MRT project — verified cheap vs real transactions, with a dated MRT + Bishan sub-regional-centre catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $998K / $1,894 psf for a 527 sqft 1BR is the lowest live 1BR listing in JadeScape — comparable 527 sqft 1BRs are listed at $1,030K-$1,144K (~$1,955-$2,170 psf) and project 12mo avg is $2,322 psf, so the -16.3% age-adj and -7.5% vs same-size cohort (25 txns, healthy depth; 347 project appreciation txns) are corroborated by real web transactions, not a data quirk. Catalyst is concrete: <200m to Marymount MRT and URA Master Plan upgrading Bishan into a sub-regional employment node. D20 sits on the OCR/RCR border, the better forward-return region in the v3.4 priors. Built 2022/2023 by reputable Qingjian (smart-home, good BCA track record). Lead value signal (cheap vs verified peers) + decisive physical catalyst justifies high confidence; tempered to Buy (not Strong Buy) because $1,894 psf is still a rich absolute entry for a 527 sqft shoebox and 1BR exit liquidity depends on the rental/investor pool.
red_flags: High absolute PSF (~$1,894) for a 527 sqft shoebox
Shoebox 1BR exit depends on a narrower investor/tenant pool
Leasehold from 2018 — ~91yrs left, fine now but decays
catalysts: URA Master Plan: Bishan to become a sub-regional employment centre
Cheapest live 1BR in a desirable 2022/2023 Qingjian project — entry-point arbitrage
